description: A delay line of as many as 9999 samples, with a feedback input and a second mode that turns it into a crude filter

params.text: Switches to a mode in which the output is the feedback signal less the average of the buffer, which acts as a crude filter, and in which the buffer is a tenth as long; its lamp is lit while it is on
Sets the length of the delay, 1 to 9999 samples
Scales the signal at the FB IN jack before it is written into the buffer, from none of it to all of it

inputs.text: The signal written into the buffer
A second signal added into the buffer, scaled by the feedback knob
A voltage here takes over from the LENGTH knob, 0V to 10V across 1 to 9999 samples

outputs.text: The signal read back out of the buffer, clamped to -10V to +10V
